Nagano site: Taiyo Yuden's own global network page lists no site in Nagano Prefecture at all — its domestic plants are Haruna, Nakanojo, Tamamura and Yawatabara (all Gunma) plus the Takasaki R&D Center. Nothing to locate.

Ome site: per Taiyo Yuden's own network page this is TAIYO YUDEN Mobile Technology Co., Ltd. (6-16-3 Shinmachi, Ome-shi, Tokyo), a module manufacturing and development operation, not a front-end wafer fab.

Genuine MEMS foundry and the operator's address is confirmed from its own contact page (Bruttovägen 1, SE-175 26 Järfälla), but no fab coordinate could be sourced. OSM has no Silex object anywhere in Sweden (checked via Nominatim country-filtered search and Photon) and no house numbers on Bruttovägen, Overpass was unreachable from this environment, and no permit document with coordinates was obtainable. Not guessing a point on the street.

Could not source the Ulm site. The operator's website (www.ums-gaas.com) is unreachable — its TLS certificate is issued for an unrelated shared host — and the bare domain does not resolve. OSM carries only UMS's French site at Villebon-sur-Yvette, nothing in Ulm; the Wilhelm-Runge-Straße 11 address block in Ulm geocodes to office buildings of the science-city campus, which I could not confirm as the GaAs fab.

Could not locate the fab building. Sanan's own contact page gives the site as "No. 2 Core Industry, Lianshan Industry Area, Gushan Village, Shijing Town, Nanan City, Quanzhou" — that resolves only to Gushan village (OSM node 11195501748, inside the Shijing town boundary relation 12113618), not to a plant. Overpass returned no Sanan-named object anywhere in Fujian except the Xiamen plant (way 151311482), and no identifiable industrial parcel within 3 km of the village. Rather than place a coordinate on a village centroid, skipped.

No defensible coordinate. This is Shanghai Huali Microelectronics' 12-inch Zhangjiang fab, not a Hua Hong Grace fab, and HHGrace's own site lists only Fab1/2/3/7/9. hlmc.com.cn is now a parked domain for sale, so there is no operator page. Overpass found no 华力 / Huali / HLMC object anywhere in Shanghai and no industrial landuse along 高斯路 (Gaosi Road); the only address I saw (高斯路497号) came from a third-party recruiting site, which is not a source I would geolocate from.

Same problem as Fab5, worse. Operator would be Shanghai Huali Integrated Circuit Manufacturing Co. in Kangqiao; no operator website reachable, no OSM object for the company anywhere in Shanghai, and Nominatim does not even know the 良腾路 street cited by third-party business directories. No coordinate I could justify.

Could not verify anything. The worklist gives no city at all (location is just "China"), and every general web search route available to me was exhausted or blocked — the WebSearch budget ran out, Brave returned HTTP 429 repeatedly, DuckDuckGo served a CAPTCHA (which I will not solve), and Bing returned unrelated results. No operator domain resolved. Nothing sourced, so nothing returned.

Not a fab. The Hefei DRAM venture led by the former Elpida CEO was never built — reporting I fetched states the effort to start a memory company in China was suspended, and there is no operating facility under this name.

Not a front-end wafer fab. APT Electronics Co., Ltd. describes itself on its own site as building from "semiconductor packaging and optical systems to end applications" — LED devices, modules and lighting/display systems at No. 33 South Huanshi Avenue, Nansha District, Guangzhou. That is packaging and module assembly, not wafer fabrication.

Could not identify the company or confirm a wafer fab in Guangzhou. No operator domain resolved (aqualite.cn and aqualite-china.com both failed to connect), Overpass found no matching site in the Guangzhou area, and all remaining search engines were rate-limited, CAPTCHA-gated or returning junk. Unverifiable.
Same as the Guangzhou entry — no operator source, no OSM object in the Wuhan area, and no usable search route left. Could not confirm this is a wafer fab, let alone locate it.

Skipped as a former name / not a current wafer fab. The ACRA-registered entity behind UEN 200004200M is live but now named AAC Global Sourcing Services, formerly SensFab, at 22 Tampines Industrial Crescent #03-01 — a unit in a multi-tenant industrial building, with a wholesale trade activity code alongside the manufacturing one. No SensFab website exists. I could not confirm an operating MEMS wafer fab there.

R&D line, not a production fab. MIMOS Berhad is Malaysia's state-owned R&D centre under MOSTI; its own site describes the facility as a "Wafer Fabrication and Prototyping" lab running 200 mm wafers at small-to-medium volume for prototyping. The OSM object at Technology Park Malaysia (way 201431648) is tagged office=research. Per the brief's instruction to skip R&D lines.

No independent primary source exists that I can fetch. There is no operator website, no filing, no permit document, and no OSM object I could tie to this plant. Any coordinate would be a guess, so skipped.

Could not locate the plant. Both plausible company domains (crocusnano.ru, cnetech.ru) fail to resolve from here; a full OSM bbox sweep of Zelenograd and of the Alabushevo special economic zone returned no Crocus object of any kind, and no independent document giving the plant's street address could be fetched. Skipped rather than guess a coordinate.

R&D institute, not a front-end wafer fab. niiis.nnov.ru presents the Sedakov Research Institute of Measuring Systems (a Rosatom institute) with sections for research, procurement and disclosure but no wafer-fabrication production, and its published postal address is a PO box (603952, Нижний Новгород, Бокс № 486), which cannot anchor a plant coordinate.

No independent source obtainable. No company domain resolved (sintezmk.ru, sintez-mk.ru), no OSM object, and no government or press document could be fetched to confirm that a fab exists in Voronezh, let alone where. Skipped rather than invent a coordinate.

russianspacesystems.ru returns HTTP 403 from this environment, and nothing else fetched shows front-end wafer fabrication at this site — RSS is a spacecraft-instrumentation and radio-electronics house. The bare 'Moscow' location in the worklist would in any case resolve to its corporate headquarters, exactly the failure mode the brief warns about.

Could not verify a fab or locate one. okbplaneta.ru serves only a cookie-setting redirect stub, with no content retrievable with or without the cookie. The single OSM object is node 9867813018, an office=company node at Bolshaya Moskovskaya 13A in the Veliky Novgorod city centre — an office, not a plant. The worklist row also attaches Svetlana-Rost's plant name to OKB-Planeta, which looks like a source-table error.

Back-end site, not a front-end wafer fab. HT Micron's own site describes a semiconductor packaging operation (memory and SiP/iMCP IoT modules such as HTLRBL32L and HTNB32L) at Avenida Unisinos 1550, São Leopoldo — assembly, packaging and test, with no wafer front end.

Could not confirm a wafer fab. EPA records do confirm a Honeywell facility at 15001 NE 36th St, Redmond WA (TRI id 98073SNDST15001, parent Honeywell International Inc, last TRI reporting year 2008, FRS registry id 110000827614), but nothing fetchable shows front-end wafer fabrication there, and OSM now places those buildings ('Honeywell Building 1/3/4') inside the Microsoft West Campus. Honeywell's own site could not be searched because this session's web-search budget was already exhausted. Not enough to assert a fab.

Same site as the FAB1 record. AOI's FY2025 Form 10-K states it manufactures its laser chips 'only within our Sugar Land facility' and lists a single Sugar Land property line (139,450 sq ft); the risk factors likewise refer to one 'wafer fabrication facility in Sugar Land, Texas'. No independent source distinguishes a separate FAB2 building, so it is folded into the Sugar Land record rather than double-counted. (A second Sugar Land property, 1111 Gillingham Lane, was leased in September 2025 for 'manufacturing and related operations', but the filing does not describe it as wafer fabrication.)

Contact-image-sensor (CIS) module maker, not a front-end wafer fab — the Nanchang site is module assembly. The company's own site (cis.com.tw) is no longer live (the domain now serves unrelated content), so no independent primary source exists for the plant, its address or its coordinates.
Same as the Nanchang row: contact-image-sensor module assembly rather than wafer fabrication, and no live operator website or other primary source to confirm a plant location.

plant: Wuxi Creative Sensor (listed under Taiwan, Taipei City)
reason: Duplicate of the Wuxi row — the same plant listed a second time under the company's Taipei office location. Also a CIS module site, not a wafer fab.

University shared research cleanroom (HKUST's Nanosystem Fabrication Facility, Clear Water Bay, plus an 8-inch research line at HKUST Guangzhou), i.e. an R&D line open to academic users, not a production wafer fab. Confirmed at https://nff.hkust.edu.hk/en/home.html and https://funh.hkust-gz.edu.cn/research/crf/.
Duplicate row for the same Shenzhen plant already returned as the SISEMI Baolong wafer fab (深圳深爱半导体, Baolong 7th Rd, Longgang). Only one record kept.

plant: Xiamen San'an Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd.

OSM has no object for San'an anywhere in Xiamen (checked bboxes covering Xiang'an and Tong'an/Hongtang), the only published address is a street range without geocodable house numbers (No.841-899 Min'an Avenue), and no environmental filing with 地理坐标 for this plant was reachable. Skipped rather than place an invented pin.
Second legal entity at the same Xiamen Min'an Avenue LED site as the row above; skipped for the same reason (no sourceable plant coordinate) and because it would duplicate that site.

Not a wafer fab. San'an's own page for Anrui Optoelectronics (No.11 North Fengming Road, Wuhu ETDZ) describes automotive lighting: headlamp, rear-combination and signal-lamp design and assembly, with capacity quoted in lamp sets per year. Source: https://www.sanan-e.com/en/anrui.

Genuine GaAs/GaN RF wafer foundry (厦门市三安集成电路有限公司, founded May 2014), but no plant coordinate could be sourced. Its own site publishes no plant address, and the only addresses in circulation are the registered office in the Torch Plaza office building in Xiamen Torch Hi-tech Zone — exactly the office-versus-plant trap — while OSM has no object for it.
